User.title: User
User.description: Represents a user of the TeamUp application.

id.description: Unique identifier for the user entity.

preferredLanguage.description: The user's preferred language, stored to persist language selection.

Config.title: Config
Config.description: Represents a saved team generation configuration.

name.description: The user-provided name for the configuration.

userId.description: The ID of the user who owns this configuration.

configData.description: A JSON string representing the application state to be saved.

definition.description: Stores user profiles, including preferred language.
Stores multiple saved configurations for a specific user.
